contract_modal.title: Secure Payment Contract
contract_modal.hero_title: How Your Secure Payment Contract Works
contract_modal.hero_description: The hirer locks Bitcoin or Lightning in escrow. USDT coming soon. BitTasker cannot spend it. The hirer pays the worker after approving the work.
contract_modal.money_protected_locked: The amount stays in escrow until the hirer approves the work and pays the invoice.
contract_modal.money_protected_no_intermediaries: No intermediaries. Direct peer-to-peer; only you and the other party can interact with your contract.
contract_modal.for_taskers_locked: Funds stay locked until you accept completed work.
contract_modal.for_taskers_review: After the worker submits the work, you approve it. Nothing is paid if you wait.
contract_modal.for_taskers_grace: You can cancel while the contract is still open and unpaid.
contract_modal.for_taskers_dispute: If you disagree, do not pay the invoice. Cancel the open contract. There is no automatic refund.
contract_modal.for_taskers_cancel: Cancel is on the contract page while the job is open and unpaid.
contract_modal.for_taskers_no_show: If the worker has not delivered, cancel the open contract. Waiting does not refund you.
contract_modal.for_taskees_guaranteed: After the hirer approves, request payment. They pay that invoice, usually within a few minutes.
contract_modal.for_taskees_upfront: The amount locked is the agreed price. There is no separate upfront payment.
contract_modal.for_taskees_dispute: Use the bid until escrow is formed. After that, messages open between you and the hirer.
contract_modal.for_taskees_refund: A refund, if you agree one, is a separate payment. It is not automatic.
contract_modal.platform_fees_both: Both parties pay a fee to BitTasker.
contract_modal.platform_fees_deducted: Fees are deducted when money moves, not upfront.
contract_modal.platform_fees_apply: Fees apply to upfront deposits, final payments, dispute resolutions, and cancellation fees.
contract_modal.time_limits_grace: Cancel while the contract is still open and unpaid.
contract_modal.time_limits_cancellation: Once the invoice is paid, that payment is final.
contract_modal.time_limits_review: The hirer approves the work, then pays. There is no review timer.
contract_modal.time_limits_dispute_resolution: There is no automatic refund if you disagree.
contract_modal.time_limits_dispute_filing: Do not pay the invoice if the work is not acceptable.
contract_modal.time_limits_no_show: If work has not started, cancel the open contract.
contract_modal.dispute_process_step2: Cancel while the contract is still open and unpaid.
contract_modal.dispute_process_step3: Talk in the bid before escrow, or in messages after escrow is formed.
contract_modal.cancellation_tasker_one_hour: Cancel while the contract is open and unpaid.
contract_modal.cancellation_tasker_after_hour: Cancelling does not by itself send a refund.
contract_modal.cancellation_tasker_24_hours: You cannot cancel after the invoice is paid.
contract_modal.cancellation_taskee_anytime: The worker can cancel an open, unpaid contract too.
contract_modal.agreeing_to_funds: Funds are locked and only released per contract rules.
contract_modal.agreeing_to_time: There is no automatic payment timer.
contract_modal.agreeing_to_fees: Fees are transparent and deducted automatically.
contract_modal.agreeing_to_disputes: Disagreement means you cancel or you do not pay. Nobody else decides the split.
contract_modal.agreeing_to_no_reversals: No reversals: blockchain transactions are permanent once executed.
contract_modal.not_agreeing_to_access: Letting anyone access funds outside contract rules.
contract_modal.not_agreeing_to_indefinite: Pay the invoice after you approve. Do not leave the worker guessing.
contract_modal.not_agreeing_to_standards: Accepting work that doesn't meet agreed standards.
contract_modal.not_agreeing_to_stuck: Cancel while the contract is open and unpaid.
contract_modal.not_agreeing_to_third_party: A third party determining the outcome of payments.
contract_modal.summary: Escrow holds the money until you approve the work and pay the invoice. Messages open after escrow is formed. Reviews open after payment.
